title: SQL Injection on Accounts Filter Endpoint
description: The dynamic 'sort' parameter is concatenated directly into SQL queries without parameterized binding, allowing remote database schema extraction.
impact: Unauthenticated attackers can extract user hashes, account ledger balances, and database internal configurations.
steps_to_reproduce: Send a GET request to /v1/accounts?sort=id and observe the baseline response.
Append a boolean SQL condition payload to the sort parameter: /v1/accounts?sort=id%20DESC.
Observe deterministic query behavior and syntax errors confirming backend SQL execution.
raw_http_request:
GET /v1/accounts?sort=id' HTTP/1.1
Host: api.acmefintech.local
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0
Accept: application/json

title: Broken Object Level Authorization (IDOR) on Invoice Retrieval
description: The invoice API endpoint checks session authentication but fails to verify whether the requested invoice identifier belongs to the requesting tenant.
impact: Authenticated users can read, download, and iterate all tenant invoices across the entire application ecosystem.
steps_to_reproduce: Log into Account A and inspect an owned invoice at /api/invoices/9920.
Log into Account B in an isolated incognito browser session.
Request /api/invoices/9920 from Account B's session and observe that Account A's invoice is returned with HTTP 200 OK.
raw_http_request:
GET /api/invoices/9920?api_key=live_sec_991827364 HTTP/1.1
Host: app.acmefintech.local
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.dummysecret
Cookie: session_id=sess_dummy9988; auth_token=secret_tok_1234

title: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) on Search Query Parameter
description: User input in the 'q' parameter is reflected directly into HTML output without contextual entity encoding.
impact: Attackers can construct malicious URLs that execute arbitrary client-side JavaScript in victims' browser contexts.
steps_to_reproduce: Inject a harmless test payload into the query parameter.
Observe DOM execution within the rendering tree.

title: Software Version Disclosure on Legacy Blog Subdomain
description: The server exposes detailed web server build versions on the blog subdomain (Target is explicitly Out-of-Scope).
impact: Provides preliminary version fingerprinting data to attackers.
steps_to_reproduce: Send an HTTP HEAD request to https://blog.acmefintech.local/server-status.
